name: ESO 540-014 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 540-014, a nearby galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso540014-hubble
story: Astronomers picked ESO 540-014 as a quiet, rounded galaxy to search for a slowly feeding black hole, but Hubble's sharper view showed an irregular shape instead.

claims.text: ESO 540-014 was a target of a Hubble snapshot survey of faint nearby spheroidal galaxies, searching for low-level black hole accretion and nuclear star clusters
Hubble's ACS images showed ESO 540-014 has irregular or non-early-type morphology
